Revolving credit facilities as of december 31, 2015, aon plc had two committed credit facilities outstanding: its $ 400 million u.s. Credit facility expiring in march 2017 (the "2017 facility") and $ 900 million multi-currency u.s. Credit facility expiring in february 2020 (the "2020 facility"). The 2020 facility was entered into on february 2, 2015 and replaced the previous 20ac650 million european credit facility.
